##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 24 August 2026 at 7:35am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Occasional strong winds later.


##Synopsis##

High pressure centred in the North Sea.


##Wind##

East or southeast 3 or 4, occasionally 5 in places, increasing 4 or 5 through the evening, perhaps touching 6 in the south of the area for a time early in the night.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight later.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East 4 or 5, becoming 5 or 6 for a time tomorrow evening, decreasing 4 or 5 again overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.
